answer.forgot: That happens. A fixed time helps, for example after brushing your teeth. Tomorrow is a new day.
answer.unclear: Thank you. The practice will see this before your next appointment and show you the exercise again.
answer.no_time: Understandable. Even one exercise is better than none.
answer.no_time_star: Understandable. When time is short: do only the exercises with the star.
answer.pain: Do not continue the exercise while it hurts a lot, and contact the practice. In an emergency, call 144.
answer.app: Thank you. Ask at reception on your next visit – we are happy to help you with the app.
answer.no_benefit: Thank you for being honest. Bring it up at your next appointment – you will look at your goal together.
